info.name: BigCommerce Abandoned Cart Emails Listings API

params.name: limit
params.description: Controls the number of items per page for paginated responses.

params.name: after
params.description: Specifies the prior listing ID in a limited (paginated) list of listings.

params.name: product_id:in
params.description: Filter items by a comma-separated list of product IDs.

params.name: date_created
params.description: Filter items by date_created. For example, `date_created=2019-09-04T00:00:00`, `date_created=2019-09-04`, or `date_created=1567573200`

params.name: date_created:min
params.description: Filter items by minimum date_created. For example, `date_created:min=2019-09-04T00:00:00`, `date_created:min=2019-09-04`, or `date_created:min=1567573200`

params.name: date_created:max
params.description: Filter items by maximum date_created. For example, `date_created:max=2019-09-04T00:00:00`, `date_created:max=2019-09-04`, or `date_created:max=1567573200`

params.name: date_modified
params.description: Filter items by date_modified. For example, `date_modified=2019-09-04T00:00:00`, `date_modified=2019-09-04`, or `date_modified=1567573200`

params.name: date_modified:min
params.description: Filter items by minimum date_modified. For example, `date_modified:min=2019-09-04T00:00:00`, `date_modified:min=2019-09-04`, or `date_modified:min=1567573200`

params.name: date_modified:max
params.description: Filter items by maximum date_modified. For example, `date_modified:max=2019-09-04T00:00:00`, `date_modified:max=2019-09-04`, or `date_modified:max=1567573200`
